title: Control Board Communication Fault
shortDescription: Main PCB cannot communicate with display/UI board.
fullDescription:
E01 on Zanussi dryers (Electrolux group platform) indicates communication failure between the control PCB and the user interface or auxiliary board.

Usually caused by loose cables, corroded connectors, or PCB failure. A 10-minute power cycle clears many transient faults.

title: Motor Tacho Fault
fullDescription: E02 indicates the PCB cannot read motor tacho. Most often a broken drive belt, failed tacho coil, or worn brushes.

title: NTC Temperature Sensor Fault
fullDescription: E03 indicates the NTC thermistor is reporting out-of-range values. Replacement sensors are inexpensive DIY swaps.

title: Pressure Switch Fault
fullDescription: E04 means the pressure switch reports an invalid state. Check tank and hose before parts swap.

title: Drain Pump Fault
fullDescription: E05 indicates the pump is blocked or failed. Start with the sump filter before stripping the machine.

title: Door Lock Fault
fullDescription: E06 means the door interlock microswitch is faulty or the catch is misaligned.

title: Heater Fault
fullDescription: E07 appears when expected temperature rise is not seen. Usually burnt element or tripped TOC.

title: Heater Relay Stuck
fullDescription: E08 is a safety code. Unplug the dryer immediately; PCB replacement required.

title: Software ROM Error
fullDescription: E09 indicates corrupt firmware on the PCB. Replacement with programmed board usually required.

title: EEPROM Checksum Error
fullDescription: E10 means the EEPROM has failed checksum. PCB replacement required.
